title: Paolo Panelo issued show cause order by Senate impeachment court
summary: The Senate impeachment court on Friday issued a show cause order against Vice President Sara Duterte's spokesperson, lawyer Paolo Panelo, over his comments regarding the alleged partiality of several…

blocks.text: The Senate impeachment court on Friday issued a show cause order against Vice President Sara Duterte's spokesperson, lawyer Paolo Panelo, over his comments regarding the alleged partiality of several senator-judges.

Senator-judge Erwin Tulfo raised concerns about Panelo's statements on Day 45 of Duterte's impeachment trial, asking Senate impeachment presiding officer Francis Escudero if there was something the court could do about it.
Panelo had asserted that some senator-judges were acting as prosecutors.

Tulfo said, "He's not party to this case pero siya po ang tagapagsalita ng bise presidente. Tama po ba 'yun? I believe parang mayroong problema dito. I mean, you are the spokesperson of the vice president, na on trial here, and then magkokomento ko hinggil sa senator-judges of the impeachment court."

(He's not party to this case but he's the spokesperson of the vice president. Is that proper? I believe there seems to be a problem here. I mean, you are the spokesperson of the vice president who is on trial here, and then you make comments about the senator-judges of the impeachment court.)

Escudero replied by saying that Panelo was not a lawyer nor witness in the trial, so he was not covered by the sub judice ruling. However, Escudero said that with the suppletory application of the Rules of Court, specifically Rule 71 on the Rules of Contempt, Panelo is susceptible to any orders by the court in relation to speech or action about the court.
"If I understand the motion, instead of asking him to explain, it will be in the form of a show cause order, Honorable Senator-judge Erwin. Is that your pleasure, sir?" Escudero said.
"Yes, Mister Presiding Officer. That's my point, sir… I will therefore file a motion to issue a show cause order for the spokesperson of the vice president," Tulfo said.
With no one objecting to the motion, Escudero directed the Clerk of Court to issue the show cause order.
GMA News Online has requested comment from Panelo regarding the matter, but he has yet to respond as of posting time. — VDV, GMA News
